prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: STL decomposition shows consistent upward trend across both folds with moderate seasonality. Multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with rf selected as trend champion. DWT_catboost leads in seasonal capture (0.448 correlation) while ONLY_CWT_catboost achieves lowest overall RMSE (35.16). High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=118.17), concept drift detection, and split trend/seasonality champions warrant STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit additive decomposition while handling drift and residual autocorrelation.
